clarifications_resolved.decision: Use a replicated data cache with a synchronous call in case of a missing 'ProductID', and expire cached items on updates to the product catalog and after a configurable age (default to 24 hours).

clarifications_resolved.decision: Historical MSRP records are read-only once effectiveEndDate has passed. Corrections permitted only via: (A) Superseding Correction Record with audit trail, (B) Prospective Adjustment Only, or (C) Exceptional Administrative Override with formal approval. Full audit trail required for all corrections.
